newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Israeli group plans Venezuelan diamond exchange.
newsitem.headline: Israeli group plans Venezuelan diamond exchange.

text.p: A group of Israeli businessmen are planning to open Latin America's first diamond exchange in Venezuela's rich mining region of Guyana, an Israeli official said on Tuesday.
Yosef Kemper, president of the Israeli chamber of commerce in Latin America, said the precious stone exchange would rank number 24 in the world when it opens in two years.
The promotion team for the project was formally installed Tuesday in Cuidad Guayana, Venezuela's industrial and mining centre 700 kilometres southeast of Caracas.
The exchange would offer banking and insurance services and was also aiming to cover precious stone markets in Brazil, Guyana and Colombia.
